title: 4 Vietnamese Ghosts Roast the Living | Animated Horror Comedy
description:
Four Vietnamese folk ghosts tell their side of the story — and the living do not come out of it well.

0:00 ma lai: He Livestreamed His Mom Sleeping. Her Head Hid in the Rice Cooker.
3:59 than trung: The Underworld Took Attendance at 3 A.M. — and Marked the Boss Present
8:12 ma xo: Three Generations Guarded This Jar. Nobody Was Allowed to Open It.
12:04 ma giau: For Three Days, Nobody Looked Up From Their Screens

Fictional stories inspired by Vietnamese folklore. Voices and images were made with AI.

@ThePettyGhost — a petty little house ghost tells you what the living get up to.
